title: Graphs
definition: A graph consists of vertices (nodes) connected by edges.
intuition: Models arbitrary networks: friendships, roads, routing maps, dependency graphs.
how_it_works: Represented by adjacency lists or adjacency matrices. Nodes can be visited using BFS/DFS.
when_to_use: When relationships are complex and cyclic.
when_not_to_use: When a simpler linear or tree representation is sufficient.
common_mistakes: Ignoring infinite recursion due to cycles (need visited sets)
Index out of range in matrices
complexity: DFS/BFS: O(V + E) with adjacency list
content: A graph consists of vertices (nodes) connected by edges.
